field_meaning.hi: ऑडियो ट्रैक को एक फाइल में रिकॉर्ड करना।

review_objections: Alibaba: While 'bounce' is used in audio, the Hindi definition 'Recording an audio track into a file' is slightly imprecise. Bouncing usually refers to rendering multiple tracks into a single stereo file (summing), not just recording a single track.
